instruction: Candid full-body documentary photograph of a couple walking in a bright indoor garden atrium. On the left, the woman in the white hijab and dress (R2) walks forward, looking towards her partner. On the right, the man in the white shirt and light blue jeans (R1) walks alongside her, smiling warmly. They hold hands in the center as they walk. The background features lush green plants and white floral decorations under soft, bright natural light.
